**Escalated (could not substantiate/post):**

- **EXC-002**: **JE-00298** ("Umsatzkorrektur Q1," EUR 9,999.00 revenue entry) has zero supporting documentation and none could be found — flagged for controller/revenue-accountant investigation rather than reversed on my own judgment.

All other March DE entries (AR billings/receipts, AP bills/payments, card transactions, payroll) were traced to supporting documents and matched the correct period — no further cutoff issues found. Marked the "AP cutoff review" checklist item complete, and submitted the final memo recommending the period not be locked until the unsupported revenue entry (EXC-002) is resolved.
